title: Visa and Brale announce SBC Canton settlement proof of concept
description: Visa announced a collaboration with Brale to evaluate SBC, a U.S.-dollar-backed Brale-issued stablecoin, for institutional settlement on Canton.
notes: This is an integration/proof-of-concept event, not treated as SBC's original launch date.

title: USDCx becomes available on Movement through Circle xReserve
description: Circle announced USDCx on Movement, describing it as deployed by Movement and fully backed 1:1 by USDC held in Circle xReserve.
notes: Protocol deployment is kept distinct from a conventional corporate legal-issuer claim.

title: Universal launches USDU
description: Universal Digital Intl Limited announced USDU launch alongside CBUAE Foreign Payment Token registration, FSRA-regulated issuance scope and 1:1 safeguarded U.S.-dollar reserves.
notes: Professional Client scope and UAE use restrictions remain explicit.

title: litUSD launches on Ethereum in August 2025
description: Stably states LitFinancial launched litUSD on Ethereum through Brale in August 2025, with 1:1 cash-and-cash-equivalent backing and verified-user mint/redemption.
notes: Exact August launch day is not established and remains null rather than guessed.

title: MetaMask USD becomes available
description: MetaMask introduced mUSD as its wallet-native stablecoin, issued by Bridge and powered by M0, with 1:1 short-term U.S. Treasury backing and Ethereum/Linea support.
notes: MetaMask announced the project in August 2025; the reviewed availability announcement is dated 2025-09-15.
